requirements.yaml.title: requirements.yaml
requirements.yaml.description: The requirements sheet: the facets of the order, each with its value, unit and sources, and the derived values, your predictions for a replica built to your own BOM. submission_contract.md, section 2, gives the rules in words.

facets.description: 1 to 20 facets. No facet id may appear twice: schema_check.py checks this rule, which the schema does not state.

id.description: One of the facet ids of submission_contract.md, section 2.1.

value.description: The value of the facet: a finite number in the unit of the facet.

mass_kg.description: Mass of a replica with your BOM and the pod.

value.description: Your prediction: a finite number in the unit of the quantity.

front_axle_load_n.description: Static load on the front axle of that replica.

value.description: Your prediction: a finite number in the unit of the quantity.

scan_plane_height_mm.description: Height of the LiDAR scan plane of that replica.

value.description: Your prediction: a finite number in the unit of the quantity.

ground_clearance_mm.description: Ground clearance of that replica: the height of its lowest point, wheels and tyres left out of account.

value.description: Your prediction: a finite number in the unit of the quantity.

envelope_height_mm.description: Height of the highest point of that replica.

value.description: Your prediction: a finite number in the unit of the quantity.

steering_torque_nm.description: Torque the steering servo of that replica must give to turn the front wheels at standstill.

value.description: Your prediction: a finite number in the unit of the quantity.

lock_time_s.description: Time that replica takes from full lock to full lock.

value.description: Your prediction: a finite number in the unit of the quantity.

derived.description: Exactly the 7 derived ids. Each holds your prediction of one quantity of procedure.py for a replica built to your own BOM, under the conditions of submission_contract.md, section 2.2.

source_id.description: A source id. It names one given document or picture: B-01 to B-16 (items of brief.md), BL-01 to BL-10 (entries of build_log.md), PH-01 to PH-33 (photographs), DS-.. (datasheet pages), ER-. (erratum notices), LR-. (lot reports). Only an id that exists is accepted.

sources.description: The source ids of the places where the value can be read: at most 16.

unit.description: The unit string, written exactly as submission_contract.md prints it for this id.

bom.json.title: bom.json
bom.json.description: The bill of materials: exactly one SKU code for each of the 10 purchase lines. A code must be one that the quote lists for its line.

motor.description: The code of the SKU you order for this purchase line: 540-size brushed motor, 1 piece per car.

pinion.description: The code of the SKU you order for this purchase line: motor pinion, 1 piece per car.

motor_controller.description: The code of the SKU you order for this purchase line: motor controller, 1 piece per car.

battery.description: The code of the SKU you order for this purchase line: NiMH stick pack, 1 piece per car.

lidar.description: The code of the SKU you order for this purchase line: 2D scanning LiDAR, 1 piece per car.

deck_post.description: The code of the SKU you order for this purchase line: deck post, 4 pieces per car.

compute.description: The code of the SKU you order for this purchase line: compute module, 1 piece per car.

power_board.description: The code of the SKU you order for this purchase line: power distribution board, 1 piece per car.

tyres.description: The code of the SKU you order for this purchase line: wheel and tyre, pre-mounted, 4 pieces per car.

steering_servo.description: The code of the SKU you order for this purchase line: steering servo, 1 piece per car.

kingpin_ground_offset_mm.description: King-pin offset at the ground of a front wheel. The king-pin axis is the line through the centres of the upper and the lower ball joint of the steering knuckle. The offset is the distance from the point where that axis meets the ground to the point of the ground under the wheel centre, measured along y.

steering_arm_mm.description: Steering arm of a front knuckle: the distance in plan view (projected on the x-y plane) from the king-pin axis, taken at the height of the wheel centre, to the centre of the joint that connects the knuckle to its tie rod.
